meta.source: Figma: TASC - UI Design (PAjLwIsSvGX2lDB7SUh35A), page For Dev Team

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page background and white sections.

tokens.name: bg-surface-primary
tokens.usage: Form card, table cells, white cards.

tokens.name: bg-surface-secondary
tokens.usage: Grey sections, article cards, tab track, FAQ help card. Alternates with bg-page.

tokens.name: bg-surface-tertiary
tokens.usage: Open filled accordion, image placeholders.

tokens.name: bg-surface-dark
tokens.usage: Footer, bottom of the dark gradient, comparison table columns, feature KPI tile. White text on it.

tokens.name: bg-surface-grey
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on dark: social buttons in the footer.

tokens.name: bg-dark-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the dark section gradient and the split-panel image fade.

tokens.name: bg-brand
tokens.usage: TASC teal. Stat cards, booking bar, selected calendar day. White text on it.

tokens.name: bg-brand-secondary
tokens.usage: TASC yellow. Selected tab, card hover fill, yellow stat chip. Always with text-primary on it.

tokens.name: bg-brand-tint-soft
tokens.usage: Table header row, consultant message bubble.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Start of the brand gradient (left): logo A, highlighted title phrase, icons, glows. Never a flat fill for text or buttons. As highlight text it is about 2:1 on bg-page (Figma design), so a title must still make sense with the highlight muted; it passes on dark sections.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: End of the brand gradient (right). Same rules as brand-blue.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on bg-page and bg-surface-secondary; text on yellow.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Paragraphs, card text, inactive list items on light backgrounds.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Meta lines, hints, inactive breadcrumbs and uppercase footer headings. Figma value: 3.4:1 on bg-page, below 4.5:1 for small text, so keep it to supporting lines and flag for review. 5.0:1 on bg-surface-dark.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Muted text on dark surfaces (addresses, table sub-headers, CTA strip text).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on dark sections, photos, bg-brand and bg-surface-dark.

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: Links, active breadcrumb, selected list items on light backgrounds.

tokens.name: text-brand-secondary
tokens.usage: Gold labels and links on dark surfaces only (contact strip labels, footer links).

tokens.name: text-on-yellow
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a yellow hover card.

tokens.name: border-primary
tokens.usage: Input borders, dividers, table lines on light backgrounds.

tokens.name: border-secondary
tokens.usage: Stronger rule: industries rail, input hover.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Hairline under grey thank-you bands, sub-nav border, avatar ring.

tokens.name: border-brand
tokens.usage: Focus ring and active tab underline on light backgrounds.

tokens.name: border-dark
tokens.usage: Dividers on bg-surface-dark (footer grid, comparison rows).

tokens.name: border-on-dark
tokens.usage: Outline button border on dark sections.

tokens.name: border-white
tokens.usage: Hairline around light glass cards.

tokens.name: icon-primary
tokens.usage: Icons on light backgrounds and on yellow.

tokens.name: icon-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary icons on light backgrounds.

tokens.name: icon-inverse
tokens.usage: Icons on dark, on bg-brand and on gradient tiles.

tokens.name: icon-brand
tokens.usage: Teal icons in summary rows and filled accordion carets.

tokens.name: button-bg-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Text button-text-primary.

tokens.name: button-bg-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: button-bg-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary (yellow) button fill. Text button-text-secondary.

tokens.name: button-bg-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button hover.

tokens.name: button-bg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Tertiary (light blue) button fill, light tags, time slots. Text button-text-link.

tokens.name: button-bg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button fill. Text button-text-disabled.

tokens.name: button-text-primary
tokens.usage: Label on button-bg-primary.

tokens.name: button-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Label on button-bg-secondary.

tokens.name: button-text-link
tokens.usage: Text links and tertiary button labels on light backgrounds.

tokens.name: button-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Label on a disabled button. Exempt from contrast as an inactive control.

tokens.name: input-bg-primary
tokens.usage: Input fill.

tokens.name: input-border-enabled
tokens.usage: Input border at rest. Figma value; below 3:1 on white, so the label above the field carries identification.

tokens.name: input-border-active
tokens.usage: Input border on focus.

tokens.name: input-text-label
tokens.usage: Field labels.

tokens.name: input-text-enabled
tokens.usage: Typed value.

tokens.name: input-text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text on input-bg-primary.

tokens.name: input-text-critical
tokens.usage: Required asterisk, error border and error message. Figma value: 3.9:1 on white, below 4.5:1 for the 12px message, so always pair it with the red border and flag for review.

families.heading: Montserrat, "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.body: Inter, "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: h2

styles.name: h3

styles.sample: World Class Staffing, Delivered at Scale

styles.name: h4

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Figma H5. Value list explanation, KPI tile numbers.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Figma H6. Form title, stat labels, thank-you band headings.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Card titles, quotes, CTA strip title, case study sub-heading.

styles.name: paragraph-large
styles.usage: Large supporting text on image panels.

styles.name: paragraph-medium
styles.sample: Hire, deploy and manage talent across the UAE.

styles.name: paragraph-small
styles.usage: Card text, accordion answers, breadcrumbs, footer text.
styles.sample: Comprehensive staffing solutions tailored for immediate and future needs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, tags, info-card labels, legal.

styles.name: label-large
styles.usage: Accordion questions, table headers, office names.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Input text, nav links, tabs, info-card values.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Field labels, step labels, checklist items, summary rows.

tokens.name: spacing-xs
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside x-small buttons; tab track padding.

tokens.name: spacing-sm
tokens.usage: Label to input; icon to text in buttons; tag gaps.

tokens.name: spacing-md
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: info-card label to value, social buttons.

tokens.name: spacing-lg
tokens.usage: Icon to card title; gaps in summary rows and filled accordions.

tokens.name: spacing-xl
tokens.usage: Title to lead paragraph; button groups; row gaps in wrapped card grids.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Form field gaps; info and KPI card padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding; the column gutter; form padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero title to paragraph; glass stat card padding; step card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Section heading to section body; header side padding.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Heading to logo row or industries block; split-panel side padding.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Tab panel padding; industries list gaps; footer block gaps.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Tight sections (contact strip); split-panel vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Hero side padding; CTA banner padding.

tokens.name: space-100
tokens.usage: Standard section top and bottom padding at desktop.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Content width inside a 1440px frame.

tokens.usage: Flags and tiny chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small and x-small buttons, tags, tabs, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, medium and large buttons, filled accordions, article images.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the form card, tables, CTA strip.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Images, tab and industry panels, comparison columns.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero media, wide images, CTA banner, split-panel inner corners.
